Execute a stochastic map with core-count-invariant L'Ecuyer-CMRG RNG streams

Source: R/audit-parallel-rng.R
statci_parallel_apply.Rd

Pre-generates one independent seed per element of X from a master "L'Ecuyer-CMRG" stream and evaluates FUN(X[[i]], ...) inside a locally scoped L'Ecuyer-CMRG RNG context. Because each task receives its own deterministic stream independent of worker partitioning, results are bit-for-bit identical across cores = 1, cores = 2, or any larger core count on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

Usage

statci_parallel_apply(X, FUN, ..., cores = 1L, seed = 42L)

Arguments

X

A vector or list to iterate over.

FUN

A function applied to each element of X.

...

Additional arguments passed to FUN.

cores

Integer number of worker processes (>= 1). When running under R CMD check (_R_CHECK_LIMIT_CORES_ set), cores is automatically capped at 2.

seed

Integer master seed used to derive per-task L'Ecuyer streams.

Value

A list of length length(X) containing the results of FUN.

Examples

res1 <- statci_parallel_apply(1:4, function(i) rnorm(3), cores = 1L, seed = 42L)
res2 <- statci_parallel_apply(1:4, function(i) rnorm(3), cores = 2L, seed = 42L)
identical(res1, res2)
#> [1] TRUE
